info.name: Preservica - assets with an ARK (CSV)
info.description:
# Assets with an ARK, as a CSV

*Version 2026-11-03b.* Reads two fields of each asset's MODS record:

- **Archival Resource Key**: `<identifier displayLabel="Archival Resource Key" type="ark">`, which holds the ARK blade;
- **Location (URL)**: `<physicalLocation displayLabel="Location (URL)" type="url"><url>`, which holds the full URL;

and builds a CSV with them, the asset's Preservica reference and the other fields you choose. Nothing in Preservica is changed.

**Before you start:** on this collection's **Variables** tab:
- fill in `username` and `password` in the **Current value** column (current values stay on your computer);
- set `fields` to any other fields you want, separated by commas: names from `indexed_fields.csv` in the Scripts repository (default `mods.dateCreated,xip.security_descriptor`; the title is always included);
- click **Save**.

## Steps

1. Click the collection's **⋯** menu > **Run collection**, keep requests 1 to 5 ticked, and click **Run**. Request 4 repeats until every asset's MODS record is read (about 2 requests per asset, 5 assets per send). Sending the requests one at a time also works: send 4 again until its Visualize tab says all are done.
2. Open **5. Show the CSV** and its **Visualize** tab: counts of what was found, a **Download CSV** button, the CSV in a box, and the first 200 rows.

## The columns

| Column | What it holds |
|---|---|
| `preservica_reference` | The asset's reference (UUID) |
| `preservica_ref` | The same as `IO_<UUID>`, as in the ARK manifest |
| `title` | The asset's title |
| `ark_blade (Archival Resource Key)` | The MODS Archival Resource Key identifier, as entered |
| `location_url (Location (URL))` | The MODS Location (URL), as entered |
| `ark` | The full ARK, `ark:/32498/...`: from the URL if it holds an ARK, otherwise the NAAN (`naan`, default 32498) plus the blade |
| `ark_status` | `both, match`, `both, DIFFERENT` (the blade and the URL name different ARKs), `URL has no ARK`, `blade only`, `URL only`, `neither`, or a problem reading the record |
| `source_id` | The MODS Source ID (local identifier) |
| `top_level_folder` | The top-level folder the asset is in |
| then | Your `fields`, in order |

## Settings

- `onlyWithArk` (default `true`): only assets with a blade or a URL. Set it to `false` and send request 5 again to list every asset, including those whose ARK fields are still empty.
- `naan`: the NAAN put in front of a bare blade (default `32498`).
- `folderRefs`: folder references, separated by commas, to cover only those folders.
- `assetsPerSend`: assets read per send of request 4 (default 5).

## If something goes wrong

Send **6. Debug: one asset's MODS** on its own. It shows an asset's MODS record (the first with an ARK, or the one in `debugAsset`), exactly what the collection read from it, and how far the last run got. It shows no password or token.

// last run got. Nothing is changed.
const send = url => new Promise((ok, fail) => pm.sendRequest({ url, header: { 'Preservica-Access-Token': pm.collectionVariables.get('token') } }, (e, r) => e ? fail(e) : ok(r)));
// MODS may come inline or escaped inside <Content>.
// <identifier displayLabel="Archival Resource Key" type="ark">blade</identifier> (and the Source ID)
const type = attrOf(m[1], 'type').toLowerCase(), label = attrOf(m[1], 'displayLabel').toLowerCase(), val = unesc(m[2]);
// Also <location><url displayLabel="Location (URL)">…</url></location>, in case a record is laid out that way.
// The ARK, worked out from the URL if it holds one, otherwise from the blade.
if (blade && url) status = !fromUrl[0] ? 'URL has no ARK' : (name(fromBlade) === name(`${fromUrl[1]}/${fromUrl[2]}`) ? 'both, match' : 'both, DIFFERENT');
else status = blade ? 'blade only' : url ? 'URL only' : 'neither';
const show = (name, url, res, note) => { const body = res ? res.text() : '(no answer)';
steps.push({ name, url: url.replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/, ''), code: res ? res.code : 'error', body: body.slice(0, 6000), note }); return res && res.code === 200 ? body : ''; };
const ent = show('1 the asset', `https://${server}/api/entity/information-objects/${ref}`, await send(`https://${server}/api/entity/information-objects/${ref}`), `Asset ${ref}.`);

const xml = show('2 its MODS record', frag[2].trim(), await send(frag[2].trim()), 'The collection reads <identifier type="ark"> (Archival Resource Key) and <physicalLocation type="url"><url> (Location (URL)).');
parsed = Object.assign({ asset: ref }, r, arkOf(r.blade[0] || '', r.url[0] || '', naan));
} else steps.push({ name: '2 no MODS record', url: '', code: '', body: '', note: 'This asset has no MODS record.' });
const run = { assetsFound: assets.length, assetsRead: rows.length, lastRead: pm.collectionVariables.get('readStatus') || '(request 4 has not been sent since the last log-in)',
